user.title: Configure Activity Images
user.description: Select real calendars to monitor. New calendars default to disabled. Automatic generation is a separate paid opt-in. Settings apply without reload. Disabling auto prevents new attempts, not charges for a request already sent.

data.ai_task_entity_id: AI Task provider (optional for library-only mode)
data.auto_generate_calendar_entity_ids: Auto-generate missing images (select only monitored calendars)

data_description.ai_task_entity_id: Choose an image-capable AI Task entity. Leave empty to use the existing library without generating images.
data_description.reference_media_content_id: Optional local style reference passed as an image attachment. The provider must support attachments.
data_description.calendar_lookahead_days: Number of future days included in calendar coverage.
data_description.prompt_template: Use exactly one {title} placeholder for the activity name.
data_description.auto_generate_calendar_entity_ids: Automatic missing-image requests may incur charges; confirmation is required.

confirm_auto.title: May incur AI charges
confirm_auto.description: Enable automatic missing-image generation for these calendars: {calendars}. The next automatic scan may send paid requests. Explicit rate-limit rejections may be retried up to three attempts. Provider-internal retries and charges are not controlled by this integration. Disabling later cannot cancel a request already sent.

provider_self_reference.title: Activity Images is configured to use itself
provider_self_reference.description: Open Activity Images in Settings > Devices & services and choose Reconfigure. Select a different image-capable AI Task provider, or clear the provider and automatic calendar generation to use the library only.

provider_image_unsupported.title: The selected AI Task provider cannot generate images
provider_image_unsupported.description: Open Activity Images in Settings > Devices & services and choose Reconfigure. Select a provider that supports image generation and returns a local media-source image with real transparency, or use library-only mode.

provider_attachments_unsupported.title: The selected AI Task provider cannot use the style reference
provider_attachments_unsupported.description: Open Activity Images in Settings > Devices & services and choose Reconfigure. Clear the optional reference image or select an image-capable provider that supports attachments. Existing images remain available.
